notes.title: Update is available
notes.content:
Hi guys,

We've just updated this game.
Now all 11 languages are supported in OS X build.
Fixed bug with blocked cursor on the OS X 10.7.5.
Also Cloud saves are enabled for both version Windows and OS X.

Please keep enjoy this game ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New update is available
notes.content:
Hi friends,

We've released an update for this game.

Steam Cloud saves are supported now.

The following languages were added:
Ukrainian
Italian
Spanish
Portuguese
Japanese

Also now it is easier to get an Expert achievement for completing game on Hard mode.
Now player may play first 15 minutes on non-Hard mode and after that switch to Hard mode and then complete the main chapter to get this achievement.
